messages:
sam: Heads-up — planning an autoscale policy tweak for the dedicated GPU pool 'aurora' tonight at 23:00 UTC (quiet window 23:00–23:30). Owner: sam.

sam: TL;DR: reduce min replicas 10 -> 6, keep max 100, shorten smoothing window 2m -> 30s to react faster to bursts. Goal: lower baseline cost without hurting burst latency. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4123

sam: Rollout plan: apply in canary (aurora-canary) -> monitor 10m -> roll to prod if stable. Smoke steps below. Rollback: immediate revert of PR and apply previous autoscaler config (kubectl patch command included).

maria: ack. I'll run the smoke checklist and own the 10m canary watch. Will post results here.

alex: infra will watch autoscaler-controller and node provisioning logs. I'll keep an eye on GPU pod evictions and allocation latency. Dashboard: /dashboards/aurora-autoscale (link in docs).

jordan: perf note — watch model p99 gen latency and tail token-time. If p99 increases > 150ms baseline for longer than 5m, rollback. Also check queue depth and batch sizes.

ryan_oncall: I'm on-call and available during the window. Ping me if rollback needed.

sam: Smoke checklist (run after canary apply):
```
1) kubectl get hpa -n dedicated aurora-hpa -o yaml  # confirm min/max & window
2) curl -sf https://aurora-canary.redwood/api/health || fail
3) traffic-generator --target aurora-canary --rps 50 --duration 120  # small burst test
4) run perf-script ./scripts/check_p99.sh aurora-canary
```

sam: Rollback commands (fast):
```
# revert PR (merge revert)
gh pr revert 4123 --repo redwood-inference/infra
# or patch HPA back immediately:
kubectl patch hpa aurora-hpa -n dedicated --type json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/minReplicas","value":10},{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/behavior/scaleDown/stabilizationWindowSeconds","value":120}]'
```

maria: Smoke run scheduled at 23:05 UTC on canary. I'll post logs and perf snippet.

alex: I'll tail controller logs and watch node spin-ups starting 22:50 so we see baseline trend.

jordan: I'll trigger the perf checker at 23:07 and post p50/p90/p99 snapshots.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by sam — infra/auto-policy-change #4123 -> canary at 3167894321 (ETA 23:00 UTC). Status: queued. :gear:

sam: If nobody objects, I'll kick at 23:00. Please react :white_check_mark: once you read. If you have any last-second concerns call me.

maria: :white_check_mark:

alex: :white_check_mark: watching logs

jordan: :white_check_mark: will post p99 timeline

sam: Thanks — will update thread after canary apply and again after prod cutover.

maria: quick note: make sure we have a warm fallback pool if we see pod prep time > 45s. If needed we can temporarily increase min replicas back to 10 while debugging.

sam: noted. I’ll keep the revert command at hand and ping #infra-ops if we need extra nodes.

sam: Final: planned prod rollout 23:15 UTC if canary is clean (23:00 canary -> 23:10 watch -> 23:15 prod).
